mapper.sql: deleted = 0 AND service_date >= #{today} AND status IN ('SCHEDULED','OPEN','SUSPENDED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_slot WHERE outlet_id = #{outletId} AND
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_slot WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM resource_slot s JOIN service_window w ON w.id = #{windowId} AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.outlet_id = s.outlet_id JOIN window_item_rel r ON r.window_id = w.id AND r.item_id = s.item_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.service_date >= #{today} AND s.status IN ('SCHEDULED','OPEN','SUSPENDED')
